motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: her, the coin, a sand plume or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, macro of her eye by 6.5, wide again at 9.7; moves on 2.3, 4.6, 7.2 only
sand_plumes: a plume of glittering golden sand bursts over the lens at 0.0, 4.6, 7.2, 8.5
character: a plush grey chinchilla, absurdly thick fur, enormous black eyes, huge ears, a tiny gold crown, smug and pleased with herself
props: ONE wide shallow bowl of bright golden sand on the floor, nothing stacked; ONE thick gold coin bigger than her head, smooth, no numbers; her crown; furry-windshield mic bottom right
prop_continuity: coin on the floor 0.0-2.3, in her paws 2.3-4.6, sunk into the sand from 4.6; crown on her head except 9.3-9.7
environment: a bright resort room: a wide window filling the background with turquoise sea, surf and one leaning palm; warm wooden floor, the bowl on it
lighting: blazing seaside noon, hard sun through the window, crisp shadows, high exposure, sand glittering, plumes backlit gold

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright smug female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: SHORST-ka stress the first syllable, PREH-mee-oom pod-PEE-sok
audio.pacing: the 3.0, 4.6 and 5.75 lines run together with no breath; one pause only, 2.3-3.0; voiceless after 7.2, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over

silent. She hauls the huge coin up and slams it flat against the lens, blacking out the frame
silent. The coin drops away and she is suddenly small and far off, the sea filling the window behind her
she drags the coin edge-on across the whole floor to the bowl, sweeping the frame left to right
same sentence, no breath. She heaves the coin over her head into the bowl; it sinks into the sand and is gone, a plume over the lens
same sentence, no breath. She walks straight at the lens until her head fills the whole frame
macro on one enormous eye and the crown above it, dead still into the lens, a sun glint crossing the eye
silent from now on. She hurls herself backwards into the bowl, a plume twice the size over the lens
silent. The frame is solid glowing gold; her tail whips past the lens and is gone
silent. She rises out of the sand and shakes once, hard, a ring of golden dust past the lens
silent. She lifts the crown off, huffs on it and buffs it on her belly fur until it flares
silent. She sets the crown back on, camera snaps wide: sea and palm in the window, her sitting smug in the bowl

must_appear: the bowl stands on the floor, sea and a palm in the window, she rolls in the sand at 0.3, the coin sinks into the sand at 4.6, the crown polished and put back at 9.3
